# nb-studio workflow

## workflow create

Create a workflow

Needs `update` on the `pm.workflows` settings item. The new workflow copies `copyFrom`, or the built-in statuses when it is null.

```bash
nb-studio workflow create <name> --copy-from <string>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `name`   |             |

| Flag          | Type   | Description                                                        |
| ------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--copy-from` | string | The workflow to copy; `null` for the built-in statuses. (required) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/workflows` (`projectsCreateWorkflow`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio workflow create "Design review" --copy-from <workflow>
```

## workflow delete

Delete a workflow

Needs `update` on the `pm.workflows` settings item.

```bash
nb-studio workflow delete <workflow>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `workflow` |             |

| Flag    | Type    | Description                                     |
| ------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes` | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Delete this workflow?” |

**Output:** Nothing; prints `Done.`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `DELETE /api/projects/workflows/{workflowId}` (`projectsDeleteWorkflow`)

## workflow list

List workflows

```bash
nb-studio workflow list
```

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `name`, `isDefault`, `projectCount`, `revision`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/workflows` (`projectsListWorkflows`)

## workflow preview

Preview the rule changes of a workflow definition

What saving `definition` would change in the workflow’s status rules; nothing is written.

```bash
nb-studio workflow preview <workflow>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `workflow` |             |

| Flag           | Type | Description                                                                               |
| -------------- | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--definition` | json | A workflow definition, shaped as `ProjectsWorkflowDefinition`: `{ states, transitions }`. |
| `--file`       | path | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                         |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/workflows/{workflowId}/preview` (`projectsPreviewWorkflow`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio workflow preview <workflow> --file change.json
```

## workflow set-default

Make a workflow the default

Needs `update` on the `pm.workflows` settings item. Projects without a workflow, and issues without a project, use the default.

```bash
nb-studio workflow set-default <workflow>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `workflow` |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/workflows/{workflowId}/setDefault` (`projectsSetDefaultWorkflow`)

## workflow update

Update a workflow

Needs `update` on the `pm.workflows` settings item. `definition` is a `ProjectsWorkflowDefinition`; its problems are answered as 400 `INVALID_WORKFLOW` with `metadata.issues` at their paths.

```bash
nb-studio workflow update <workflow>
```

| Argument   | Description |
| ---------- | ----------- |
| `workflow` |             |

| Flag            | Type    | Description                                                                               |
| --------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--revision`    | integer |                                                                                           |
| `--name`        | string  |                                                                                           |
| `--description` | string  |                                                                                           |
| `--definition`  | json    | A workflow definition, shaped as `ProjectsWorkflowDefinition`: `{ states, transitions }`. |
| `--file`        | path    | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                         |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/workflows/{workflowId}` (`projectsUpdateWorkflow`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio workflow get <workflow> --json > workflow.json
nb-studio workflow update <workflow> --file change.json
```
